recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered photographic composition featuring five Black subjects. A large, softly focused female portrait dominates the right side, while four male portraits in profile or three-quarter view are stacked vertically on the left. The lighting is dramatic and low-key, with deep shadows blending the figures into a dark, warm-toned background.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the large foreground face and smaller background faces
Chiaroscuro lighting defining facial contours against a dark void
Horizontal typographic header anchoring the top edge
Warm, earthy color palette unifying disparate photographic elements
coreInvariants: Low-key studio lighting with high contrast
Warm brown and deep amber color cast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large female face occupies the right 60% of the frame; four smaller male faces are stacked in a column on the left 40%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large female face on the right acts as the primary focal point due to scale and direct gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large face on the right, across to the stacked profiles on the left, then up to the text header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark brown background occupy the spaces between and behind the subjects, creating a sense of depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and dark brown (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and highlights (ochre, amber, terracotta)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the highlights; overall dark value range.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and monochrome text

composition.scale: Small relative to frame, but spans width
composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark area above the subjects' heads

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both primary and secondary text, distinguished by a bullet point separator.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and tight kerning capability.
Classic geometric proportions similar to the source.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s style soul album cover. On the right, a large, soft-focus portrait of a Black woman with an afro looking towards the camera. On the left, four smaller portraits of Black men in profile or 3/4 view, stacked vertically. Use low-key, warm studio lighting with deep brown shadows and amber highlights. The background should be a dark, moody umber.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of white text at the very top. Use a geometric sans-serif font like Avant Garde. Set in all caps with extremely tight tracking so letters almost touch. Separate the two phrases with a small bullet point.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and low-key?
Is the text tracking sufficiently tight?
Are the portraits blended softly into the dark background?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones and white?

adjustableVariables: Number of stacked portraits on the left
Intensity of the warm color cast
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any logos or record label branding
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the eyes of the subjects.
Verify the white text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the scale hierarchy between the faces is maintained.
Confirm the absence of modern digital artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large-scale foreground portrait with a vertical stack of smaller profile portraits, unified by low-key warm lighting and a top-aligned geometric sans-serif header with negative tracking.
